content.bridge_context: Deepening our understanding of numbers by exploring factors, multiples, and the special properties that make numbers unique.

units.title: Factors and Multiples
units.explanation: A factor divides a number exactly; a multiple is what you get after multiplying a number by an integer.
units.dual_language_instruction: List two factors of 6. / 6 के दो गुणनखंडों की सूची बनाएं।

units.title: Prime and Composite
units.explanation: Prime numbers have only two factors (1 and itself); composite numbers have more.
units.dual_language_instruction: Is 7 prime or composite? Why? / क्या 7 अभाज्य है या भाज्य? क्यों?
